title: Tea Forte Cafe Cup White Porcelain Tea Cup and Lid, Steeps 8 oz., Microwave and Dishwasher Safe
description:
About this item
PORCELAIN TEA CUP designed and crafted to transform a cup of tea into an experience for all the senses
CUSTOM STEEPING COVER has a small hole to reveal the leaf of our pyramid infuser - after steeping, remove the lid to enjoy a piping hot, aromatic cup of tea
AN ELEGANT ADDITION to your tea steeping ritual, use with our handcrafted silk pyramid infusers for a spa-like experience every time you steep your favorite cup of tea
A MOST WELCOMED GIFT for any tea lover, pairs perfectly with our Ceramic Tea Trays and any of our Presentation Boxes with handcrafted pyramid infusers

reviews_5s:
This cup is so unique and it’s of a high quality.There was no damage .A perfect cup for and afternoon tea.Size was perfect. Loved the lid to keep tea warmthis very special cup is a really amazing item to include with the Forte tea package.love the design. as with tea forte tradition cup is well made and thick. i don't have to fear its too fragile to use. I'm a big fan of tea and coffee in this. perfect size and stylish.Excellent quality. Super great design. Just what I was looking for.Great product. My friend loved it.This is a great little cup, just perfect for the Tea Forte pyramids. I love the cover to help keep things hot, and the little hole on top is of course for the little leaf and "stem" that is attached to the tea pyramid.
This is my "relax in the evening" cup. A perfect wind down after a busy work day while I read a book or scan the internet.
Yes, it definitely was a splurge for me, as was the tea, but I'm very glad I bought it and will continue buying the tea!
You will enjoy both!
My one little annoyance, and it's not big, so it's not even worth deducting a star, is the handle is very small and difficult to put a finger through...even for a person with slender hands and fingers like me. The best way I have found to conquer this is to just hold this beautifully simple cup in both hands, savoring the tea aroma and the warmth of the cup.
I hope you give it a try!I bought the red and the white set and mix and match the lids for color variety. I have used the cup with tea and with soup.
